lines.t: No lie is of the truth, it fades like morning dew,
The world turns hearts to shadows, but His Word makes all things new.
Be separate, O children, from the ways of pride and gain,
Let righteousness be your garment, and holiness remain.
Feed them the Bread that came down from Heaven,
The True Bread , unbroken, unshaken.
The Way, The Truth, The Life everlasting,
In this alone is the joy of the Father found.
No more speak lies to your children, not even little white lies,
For even the smallest shadow dims the light before their eyes.
Order your conduct in mercy, let love be your guide,
For the Word of The Lord is living — in Him abide.
Feed them the Bread that came down from Heaven,
The True Bread, unbroken, unshaken.
The Way, The Truth, The Life everlasting,
In this alone is the joy of the Father found.
Anything contrary is of the world’s disguise,
The mask of the evil one is hidden in its lies.
Yet light pierces darkness, His people stand apart,
Consecrated by the Spirit, the truth within their heart.
Feed them the Bread that came down from Heaven,
The True Bread, unbroken, unshaken.
The Way, The Truth, The Life everlasting,
In this alone is the joy of the Father found.
No lie is of the truth — so walk in what is pure,
The Word eternal spoken, forever shall endure.
